positions.name: DirectiveKnowledgeErasure
positions.frame: Is the speaker issuing a binding instruction to eliminate held knowledge, asserting authority over what the recipient may retain?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives commanding erasure of specific knowledge — src-1 targeting the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts, src-2 targeting all zeppelin routes. They share authority-ranking relational stance, coercive pressure, and decision-grade conviction, cohering as commands to forget and remove knowledge from the recipient's holdings.
